reading: typed-clean (the race row) and typed-early passed in both installs, each with the answer of the path the extension recorded: typed-clean late (reload_required), typed-early document_start (stale_reference). typed-late failed before its popup was taken: Claude re-took the opener while the owner's popup window held focus. The opener had been the only controlled tab, so its release set groupId=null (background.js release), and the re-take created a new Claude group with chrome.tabs.group({tabIds:[tab]}) without a window (background.js admitTab). Chrome puts a new group in the current, last-focused window, the popup, and refuses: "Tabs can only be moved to and from normal windows". The take is recorded as unknown (Input may have started).
